metadata.title: Create Reset Password Form and Validation

story.iWant: submit a new password via the reset link
story.soThat: I can regain access to my account with a new password
story.tasks: - Create reset password page route (/reset-password) - Build reset password form component with React Hook Form - Implement password visibility toggle - Add frontend password validation - Display password requirements - Create POST /api/auth/reset-password endpoint - Implement backend token validation - Hash new password with bcrypt - Update user password in database - Delete used reset token - Handle invalid/expired token errors - Add success/error UI flows - Redirect to login after success - Write unit tests (frontend + backend) - Write integration tests

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC1: Reset Password Page with Form - Frontend route: /reset-password?token={JWT} - Page displays password reset form - Extracts token from URL query parameter
### AC2: Form Fields and Requirements - New password input (type="password") - Confirm password input (type="password") - Show/hide password toggle for both fields - Submit button: "Reset Password" - Password requirements displayed: * Minimum 8 characters * At least one uppercase letter * At least one number * At least one special character (@$!%*?&)
### AC3: Frontend Validation - Validate passwords match before submission - Validate password meets all requirements - Check token exists in URL - Display validation errors inline - Disable submit until form valid
### AC4: Reset Password API Endpoint - POST /api/auth/reset-password - Request body: { token, newPassword } - Returns success response or error
### AC5: Backend Token Validation - Verify JWT token signature and expiration - Check token exists in password_reset_tokens table - Verify token hasn't expired (created_at + 1 hour) - Validate new password meets requirements - Return specific errors for each failure case
### AC6: Successful Password Reset - Hash new password with bcrypt - Update users.password_hash in database - Delete reset token from password_reset_tokens table - Return success response - Frontend redirects to /login - Show success toast: "Password reset successful! Please log in."
### AC7: Invalid/Expired Token Handling - Display error page for invalid tokens - Message: "Reset Link Invalid or Expired" - Explanation about expiration/reuse - Button: "Request New Reset Link" → links to forgot password page

story-context.constraints: - Use existing validatePassword function from auth.ts - Hash password with bcrypt before updating database - Token must be deleted after successful password reset (prevent reuse) - Verify token from password_reset_tokens table, not just JWT signature - Check token expiration: created_at + 1 hour > NOW() - Frontend must use React Hook Form for validation - Password requirements must match registration requirements exactly - Success redirect to /login page - Display toast notification on success - Invalid/expired tokens show dedicated error page, not generic error - Log successful password resets for security monitoring - Consider rate limiting reset attempts (prevent brute force) - Future: Force logout all sessions after password reset

interface.name: Token Validation Logic
interface.signature: 1. Decode JWT token (verify signature with JWT_SECRET) 2. Extract userId from token payload 3. Query password_reset_tokens table: - WHERE user_id = {userId} AND token = {token} - Check expires_at > NOW() 4. If valid: proceed with password update 5. If invalid/expired: return error
